input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it either stops working or is extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone, especially since I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me fix this?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need anything else to get started.
The issue is with my phone number 555-123-2002. That’s the line where my mobile data is either not working or is very slow. I’d appreciate your help in getting this fixed!
On my phone’s status bar, I see the airplane mode icon and a VPN icon. I don’t see any network signal strength bars or any icons like “4G”, “5G”, “LTE”, or “E”. What should I do next?

I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now, I see one bar for signal strength (which looks poor), a “2G” icon, and it says data is disabled. There’s still a VPN icon as well. What should I do next? My mobile data still isn’t working.

I’ve turned on mobile data. Now, the status bar shows one bar for signal strength (still poor), “2G”, and data is enabled. The VPN icon is still there as well. My mobile data is still not working properly—what should I try next?

I’ve changed the network mode to “4G/5G preferred.” Now, my status bar shows excellent signal strength, a “5G” icon, and data is enabled. The VPN icon is still there. Should I try using my mobile data now, or is there anything else I should do?

I disconnected the VPN, and my status bar still shows excellent signal strength, “5G,” and data enabled. However, when I tried to test my internet speed, it said there was no connection. My mobile data still isn’t working. What should I do next?

I reset the APN settings and rebooted my phone, but when I tried to use my mobile data, I still got a “no connection” message during the speed test. My status bar still shows excellent signal strength, “5G,” and data enabled. What should I try next? This is getting a bit frustrating.

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it either stops working or is extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone, especially since I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me fix this?

To help you with your mobile data issue, I’ll need to identify your account first. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth,
- Or your customer ID?

Once I have this information, I can check your line and assist you further.
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need anything else to get started.

Thank you for providing your information. To help resolve your mobile data issue, could you please confirm which phone number (or line) you are experiencing the slow or non-working data on? You have multiple lines associated with your account.

Once you confirm the specific number, I’ll guide you through some troubleshooting steps to improve your mobile data speed.
The issue is with my phone number 555-123-2002. That’s the line where my mobile data is either not working or is very slow. I’d appreciate your help in getting this fixed!

Thank you for confirming the phone number. To troubleshoot your mobile data issue, I’ll need to check a few details about your line and its current data usage.

I’ll start by checking your current data usage and plan details for your line.

Your line currently has a 5GB data limit for this billing cycle, and you’ve used about 3.2GB so far. Since you still have data remaining, let’s proceed with troubleshooting your mobile data speed and connectivity.

Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- What network signal strength you see (bars or icons)?
- If you see any icons like “4G”, “5G”, “LTE”, or “E”?
- If there’s an airplane mode icon showing?

This will help me determine the next steps to resolve your issue.
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%
On my phone’s status bar, I see the airplane mode icon and a VPN icon. I don’t see any network signal strength bars or any icons like “4G”, “5G”, “LTE”, or “E”. What should I do next?

It looks like Airplane Mode is enabled on your phone, which disables all wireless connections—including mobile data and cellular service. This is likely why you’re not seeing any signal bars or network icons.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. Once you do that, check if your mobile data connection returns and if you see signal bars and network icons (like “4G” or “5G”) in your status bar.

Let me know what you see after turning off Airplane Mode, and if your mobile data starts working or if you still experience issues.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%

I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now, I see one bar for signal strength (which looks poor), a “2G” icon, and it says data is disabled. There’s still a VPN icon as well. What should I do next? My mobile data still isn’t working.

Thank you for the update. Here’s what we need to address:

1. Your phone is connected to a 2G network, which is too slow for modern mobile data use.
2. Mobile data is currently disabled.
3. The VPN is still active, which can also affect connectivity.

Let’s start by enabling mobile data on your phone. Please turn on mobile data in your phone’s settings. Once you’ve done that, let me know if you see any changes in your status bar (such as new network icons or increased signal strength), and if your mobile data starts working.

After that, we’ll address the network mode and VPN if needed.

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%

I’ve turned on mobile data. Now, the status bar shows one bar for signal strength (still poor), “2G”, and data is enabled. The VPN icon is still there as well. My mobile data is still not working properly—what should I try next?

Since your phone is still connected to a 2G network, which is not suitable for fast mobile data, the next step is to change your network mode preference to allow 4G or 5G connections (if your device and area support it).

Please go to your phone’s network settings and set the preferred network mode to “4G/5G preferred” or “4G only.” After making this change, check your status bar again for signal strength and network type (look for “4G” or “5G”).

Let me know what you see after changing the network mode, and if your mobile data improves. If it’s still slow or not working, we’ll address the VPN next.

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%

I’ve changed the network mode to “4G/5G preferred.” Now, my status bar shows excellent signal strength, a “5G” icon, and data is enabled. The VPN icon is still there. Should I try using my mobile data now, or is there anything else I should do?

That’s great progress! With excellent signal strength and a “5G” icon, your phone is now connected to a high-speed network, which should provide excellent mobile data performance.

Before testing your mobile data, I recommend disconnecting the VPN. Sometimes, an active VPN can slow down your connection or cause issues with certain apps and websites.

Please disconnect the VPN on your phone, then try using your mobile data. Let me know if your internet speed is now excellent or if you still experience any issues.

VPN disconnected successfully.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Speed test failed: No Connection.

I disconnected the VPN, and my status bar still shows excellent signal strength, “5G,” and data enabled. However, when I tried to test my internet speed, it said there was no connection. My mobile data still isn’t working. What should I do next?

Thank you for the update. Since you now have excellent signal strength and are connected to 5G with data enabled, but still have no internet connection, the next likely cause is an issue with your phone’s APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings can prevent your phone from accessing mobile data, even if everything else looks correct.

Please reset your APN settings to the default values in your phone’s network settings. After resetting the APN settings, you must reboot your device for the changes to take effect.

Once you’ve done both steps (reset APN and reboot), try using your mobile data again and let me know if the issue is resolved.

APN settings will reset at reboot.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%

Resetting APN settings...
Restarting network services...
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Speed test failed: No Connection.

I reset the APN settings and rebooted my phone, but when I tried to use my mobile data, I still got a “no connection” message during the speed test. My status bar still shows excellent signal strength, “5G,” and data enabled. What should I try next? This is getting a bit frustrating.

Thank you for your patience and for following all the steps so far. Since you still have no mobile data connection after resetting the APN and rebooting, and all indicators (signal, 5G, data enabled) look correct, there may be an issue with your line or account that cannot be resolved through device troubleshooting.

I will transfer you to a human agent who can investigate your account and line in more detail and provide further assistance.
